description: List recent AniList activity posts from a specific user, newest first — by default every activity type (list updates, text posts, and message activity they received). Narrow it server-side with `type` and/or a `createdAfter`/`createdBefore` window rather than paging through everything and discarding. Accepts an exact AniList username directly (it's resolved to an id with one extra internal lookup) — no need to call search_user first unless you only have a partial/fuzzy name. Use search_activity instead to browse without pinning to one user. Use get_user_recent_activity instead if you just want a quick, fixed-size (5-item) recent snapshot without paginating.

createdAfter.description: Only activities created strictly after this moment — an ISO 8601 datetime with a `Z` or ±hh:mm offset (e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z). AniList stores whole seconds; an activity at exactly this second is excluded.

createdBefore.description: Only activities created strictly before this moment — same format and exclusive bound as `createdAfter`. A window where createdBefore is not after createdAfter just returns no activities, not an error.

page.description: Page number for pagination. AniList's paginated connections (search results, a title's characters/staff/reviews, activity feeds, forum comments) reject a page whose page × perPage exceeds ~5000 entries with an upstream error, so paging that deep fails rather than returning more results.

perPage.description: Results per page (max 50, AniList's own ceiling — it silently clamps anything higher).

type.description: Restrict to this activity type, or pass an array to match ANY of several (e.g. ["TEXT", "MESSAGE"]). MEDIA_LIST matches both ANIME_LIST and MANGA_LIST activities; use ANIME_LIST/MANGA_LIST to restrict to just one. MESSAGE here is messages this user received. Omit for every type.

user.description: AniList user ID, or username. An unknown ID or username errors rather than returning an empty feed.

name: get_user_activity

lastPage.description: Not currently accurate (a known AniList performance limitation) — use `hasNextPage` instead to decide whether to fetch another page.

total.description: Not currently accurate (a known AniList performance limitation) — don't rely on it to decide whether to fetch more pages.

title: Get a user's activity feed
